scope: actual compiled runtime modules with official build-stage dependencies, synthetic HTTP/PGlite fixtures; focused batched qualification, not live fixture or full upstream-suite proof

batches.name: introspect-1
selectedTests: introspection describes an active access token and rotates token_id on refresh
introspection names exactly one inactive reason, in contract order
introspection requires its own secret and a well-formed body
introspection is a 404 like any unknown route while its secret is unset

batches.name: introspect-2
selectedTests: introspection audiences compare normalized origins and echo the configured value
readyz lists exactly the audiences introspection accepts, never the secret
introspection responses and server logs never contain token material
without RelayAuth, relayhistory/session forwards the caller's own access token

batches.name: introspect-3
selectedTests: without RelayAuth, a History login failure never echoes the caller token
without RelayAuth, session reads exchange the caller token and cache per token session
with RelayAuth configured, History still receives an assertion, not the caller token
introspection verifies a supplied machine against the token user's node claims

batches.name: introspect-4
selectedTests: introspection answers machine_unclaimed once a machine's claim is released
an inactive token never reveals machine state: the token reason wins
introspection rejects a malformed machine with 400 invalid_request
introspection without a workspace answers for the token session's workspace (v1.2)

batches.name: introspect-5
selectedTests: introspection without a workspace verifies machines in the session's workspace
